tutorial_text.text:
THE MENTOR

The last of ancient kin, and your guide.



POSTURE

The Shrub uses the "Posture" mechanic.

Blocking and attacking fills enemy posture and stops posture recovery.



SPECIAL: BASH

The Shrub can bash with the "$specialBind" keyboard input,

preventing enemy attacks and blocks for a short time.

Attacks after a bash deal lethal damage if posture is full.



UNCHECKED BY PERFORMANCE

The Shrub is not defeated upon depleting stamina,

but cannot perform maneuvers without sufficient stamina.
